slides.texte_overlay:
How to become the man
people call in a crisis

1. Stay calm first

Panic spreads.
So does calm. Be the second.

2. Take a first-aid course

One weekend.
You'll know what to do
while others freeze.

3. Pick up at 2 a.m.

Your friends know
your phone is on.

4. Keep a kit in the car

Jumper cables. A flashlight.
A blanket. Water.

5. Listen before you fix

Ask what they need.
Sometimes it's just you there.

6. Check in a week later

Everyone shows up on day one.
Few show up on day seven.

7. Know useful things

How things work.
What to do. Who to call.
Learn a little every day.
